title: Req2SysMLv2: code for generating and repairing SysML v2 models from requirements with LLMs
description:
Code of Req2SysMLv2, a generate-validate-repair framework that turns structured natural-language requirements into SysML v2 models, and of the experiments and analyses of the paper that evaluates it. Includes the prompts, knowledge bases, grammar validator, evaluation scripts and tests.

This archive contains code only. The source documents, input requirements, generated models, error banks, judgments and annotation sheets are not included; they are available on request (see README.md).

The code is under Apache-2.0, except core/validate/SysMLv2/, which is under LGPL-3.0 (see THIRD_PARTY.md).
